probe: PROBE-A part 3: Theta-parity of the HH^1 class action on HH_0
description: Parity of the outer class's cocenter action under Theta = sigma_- . bar (T_i -> a - T_i), the F_p-linear shadow of the semilinear bar involution.
scope_caveat: scope-(a). This measures Theta-parity, NOT bar-parity. The bar involution is semilinear (q -> q^{-1}) and does not act on a single finite-field specialization; converting a Theta-parity result into a bar-parity claim requires accounting for the sign twist and is NOT performed here.
